Edit* thanks to all the new subscribers and views of this video. To the new folks - these are orphaned baby beavers being raised for hopefully eventual release. This beaver is Huck who prefers to play and wrestle with his humans instead of his brothers. He’s a bit slow developing. Beavers play and wrestle differently than dogs or other animals. They push each other like little sumo wrestlers or a slow car crash. Lol. If Huck didn’t want to be rolled over and rubbed he would not come back to me. I can’t make a beaver do anything they don’t want to do. Playtime looks different in beaver world. Yes he could bite me but no he doesn’t in these situations because he enjoys this playtime. Finn and Sawyer do this with each other and us humans sometimes. Thank you everyone! Beavers are amazingly cool. 

Happy squeaks and belly rubs on this dreary, rainy Groundhog Day.
